verdict.rationale: Circle documents Agent Wallets that let an AI agent hold and spend USDC autonomously "within spending policies you define," with "customizable spending controls and built-in compliance guardrails" [circle-docs-19, circle-docs-6]. Agent-initiated payment flows are also documented: Agent Nanopayments for paying x402 services in sub-cent USDC [circle-docs-20, circle-docs-7] and CLI-driven transfers and payments [circle-docs-24]. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the spend-control policy types (limits, allowlists, human approval steps), explicit agent-initiated payout flows beyond x402 pay-per-request, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
